ledger.com/mojang/authlib/GameProfile: authlib 7.0.61 made GameProfile a final record (javap: public final class com.mojang.authlib.GameProfile extends java.lang.Record): a mod subclass cannot load on 1.21.9, and an object of any other class cannot reach 1.21.9 code typed GameProfile (vanilla takes and returns the record everywhere: player profiles, skulls, the profile cache), so no facade can stand in for one. Covers the subclass's overrides of getId/getName/getProperties (calls are renamed to id/name/properties) and of equals/hashCode/toString (final in the record)

ledger.com/mojang/authlib/properties/PropertyMa: Mutating a PropertyMap that 1.21.9 itself created or decoded throws UnsupportedOperationException: authlib 7.0.61 copies every map into an ImmutableMultimap (PropertyMap(Multimap) -> ImmutableMultimap.copyOf) and its two-argument GameProfile shares PropertyMap.EMPTY. Measured on real servers with a 1.21.8-era mod: native 1.21.8 put/removeAll on a map decoded by vanilla ExtraCodecs.PROPERTY_MAP succeed; converted on 1.21.9 both throw UnsupportedOperationException; maps and profiles the mod makes itself stay mutable (bridged: rt/CbLibMutablePropertyMap). Crashing calls: put, putAll, remove, removeAll, replaceValues, clear, and mutation through get(key)/entries()/asMap()/keys()/values() views, on any map 1.21.9 made (player login profiles, the profile cache, skull/ResolvableProfile profiles, codec-decoded maps). No faithful route: the static sees only the map or profile, not where the mod got it, so it cannot write a rebuilt profile back; GameProfile is a record whose fields neither reflection nor Unsafe may write; unfreezing a vanilla map in place would mutate the shared PropertyMap.EMPTY and change the hash of profiles 1.21.9 keeps in hash maps (the record hashCode includes the properties) -- 1.21.9 behaviour would change.
